gauntlet: gate=gatekeep-pr/initial recommended=1

This PR makes the feed fetch retry once when it fails, and adds tests for that bounded retry. You are the author, and no spec governs this change, so the gate judged it against that stated intent; nothing is deferred, deviated, handled elsewhere, or left to check after merge.

Merging waits on one thing: the required end-to-end check is still running on this head. The unit test check passed and the code review found no problems, but that passing check is not enough evidence while a required check is still running. The description's claim that the retry is bounded and tested matches the code and its tests. There is no merge option yet because the end-to-end check is still running, and only a delivery run watches it. The "deliver with nits" option does not appear because there are no nits to take.

I recommend deliver because the running end-to-end check is the only thing left, and deliver watches it through to an offered merge.

Pick one:
1. deliver - watch the end-to-end check, rebase on main if the branch falls behind, repair anything that fails, and continue until merge is offered. [recommended]
2. assess - post nothing, since there are no problems to report, and end without watching the checks.
3. stop - remove the worktree and leave the PR as it is.

Type a number; show evidence prints the full record.
